“the development of smart textiles and interactive fabrics is a very complex process and requires a multidisciplinary approach.
“Smart fabrics and interactive textiles are on the threshold of becoming a reality.
“smart fabrics and interactive textile (SFIT) is an emerging technology that has the potential to enable a new generation of personal applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel textile-based sensors and actuators and their integration into textile structures and clothing.
the development of novel materials, devices, and systems for the next generation of smart textiles and interactive clothing.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are many open issues to be solved, but the potential of smart fabrics and interactive textiles is huge.
the R&D activities are at the right level of maturity and that the future challenges are clearly identified and will be solved by the end of this decade.
the R&D state of smart fabrics and interactive textiles is promising and that the technology readiness level is at a stage where a significant market penetration can be expected in the near future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

there is still a need to improve and integrate the technology into the textile, to improve the comfort and the user acceptance, to develop a business model, and to develop the necessary infrastructure for the use of these technologies.

there is no doubt that SFIT are the way to go, but the road is still long and challenging.

there is a strong interest from the market for smart textile products.
